The alien [[Krelman]] was a member of a humanoid '''species''' who strongly resembled humans, although they had six fingers on each hand, and they consumed liquids through a hole in their head, instead of through their mouths. Members of the species were capable of falling in love with humans, as Krelman fell in love with the human bartender known as [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]].<ref name="HS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species fist appeared in the 1978 television film ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' with the character Krelman, who was played by [[Harvey Korman]], appearing in the film. Krelman's unique method of drinking through the top of his head was noted by [[StarWars.com]] as number nine on their "20 Terrifying Star Wars Moments" list in [[2007]].<ref name="Terrifying">{{SWArchive|url=eu/lit/ref/f20071030/indexp13.html|text=Checklist: 20 Terrifying ''Star Wars'' Moments}}</ref> It was similarly noted as being odd by [[Alex Newborn]] in the article "[[I Have a Bad Feeling About This!]]," published in ''[[Star Wars Insider 106]]''.<ref name="Bad Feeling">{{InsiderCite|106|I Have a Bad Feeling About This!}}</ref>
